$comment: Capability registry — ADR-0003. Renamed from v1.0's mcp.servers.json.
Secrets are secret:// URIs (ADR-0015). The ${GITHUB_PAT} interpolation from v1.0 was
broken — JSON does not expand variables and no component was named as the expander.
Container images are pinned by digest via artifacts.lock.toml (ADR-0013).
ADR-0011: there is no shell capability. Its absence is a decision, not an omission.

github.note: ADR-0012 trust gate: content read from a file or web page can never trigger a push. Image digest is UNRESOLVED — GHCR needs a bearer token the fetch tooling cannot supply. Resolve with: docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server:<tag>. See Artifact_Verification_Report.md section 5 for four alternatives. requires_network=true means this capability is excluded at L0, so it does not block offline conformance.

memory.note: ADR-0010. Direct qdrant-store / qdrant-find are NOT exposed.
